en.title: Encounter by the Magpie Bridge
en.verdict: Top-Superior Luck. The heavens have woven a path where once there was a void. Your encounter is a divine decree; love is no longer a possibility, but an inevitable destiny arriving with the warmth of the morning sun.
en.omen: A celestial chime resonates through the shrine. The air grows fragrant with the scent of moon-lotus as thousands of silver-winged birds gather, their bodies shimmering with starlight, weaving an arch that spans the infinite darkness between two distant worlds.
en.action: The silver magpies beat their wings in perfect unison, fanning a golden mist toward Calyx. As the birds bridge the gap for souls, the residue of their celestial feathers falls like divine dust, coating her clockwork frame in an aura of pure luck.
en.conclusion: Calyx purrs with a resonance that shakes the temple floor. She basks in the warmth of the starlight, her copper plates glowing with newfound vitality. Her spirit is fortified, granting her {bonus} bonus power.

en.title: Encounter by the Magpie Bridge
en.verdict: The Great Weaver has finished your tapestry. Every silent longing is now a thread of gold, promising a state of total emotional fulfillment. The discord of the past is gone, replaced by a symphony of shared devotion and celestial peace.
en.omen: The sky splits to reveal a river of stars. From the depths of the nebula, a bridge of solid jade and cloud-silk manifests. The fragrance of celestial peach blossoms fills the air, signaling that your journey is under ancient, divine protection.
en.action: As the Weaver’s hand guides the ones across the jade arch, a surge of creative energy spills over. Calyx leaps into the river of light, catching the overflow of destiny. The magpies’ song synchronizes with her spirit, purifying her heart and limbs.
en.conclusion: Calyx stretches her limbs, feeling the weight of previous burdens lift. She is revitalized by the harmonic energy of the union. Her spirit hums with joy, granting her an immediate surge of {bonus} power.

en.title: Encounter by the Magpie Bridge
en.verdict: Perfect symmetry has been achieved in the spiritual plane. This omen signifies the end of searching; your heart is now a sanctuary where love is the only law, and every obstacle has burned away into pure, golden light.
en.omen: Iridescent light fills the room as a celestial arch takes form. It is the Bridge of Infinite Harmony, constructed by the spirits of fidelity. The stars themselves align to create a path of peace where none existed before.
en.action: The spirits of the magpies circle Calyx, singing a melody that mends her weary spirit. They drop fragments of starlight into her path, which she absorbs with every graceful step. The bridge’s energy flows into her, cleansing her copper joints of old grime.
en.conclusion: Calyx rolls in the celestial dust, her eyes sparkling with sapphire clarity. She is no longer just a guardian, but a beacon of the luck you drew. Her spirit overflows with {bonus} extra power.

en.title: Encounter by the Magpie Bridge
en.verdict: The Red String of Destiny has tightened, pulling you toward a resonance so certain the stars bow in recognition. Every knot of past confusion is unraveled, leaving a smooth path toward an encounter blessed by the highest spiritual laws.
en.omen: A soft, radiant silk thread descends, knitting itself into a walkway that glows with celestial energy. The air tastes of sweet mountain rain, signaling that the universe has aligned to ensure your path to companionship is smooth and luxurious.
en.action: The magpie guardians of the string flutter around Calyx, weaving protective symbols into her aura. As they tighten the bond between souls, the friction of their wings generates a spark of life-force that flows directly into her copper frame.
en.conclusion: Calyx stands tall, her copper plating reflecting a brilliant, healthy sheen. She basks in the warmth of union, her internal light burning brighter than ever. She gains a surge of {bonus} bonus power.

en.title: Encounter by the Magpie Bridge
en.verdict: You have reached a state of total fulfillment where every longing is finally met with presence. This is the sign of absolute stability and a connection that will never drift away, anchored by the wisdom of the ancient ages.
en.omen: A majestic aurora of violet and gold unfurls, creating a pulsing bridge of light. It smells of ancient incense and fresh air, a sign that a powerful, vital energy has ignited within your destiny, tempered by celestial grace.
en.action: The celestial birds perched upon the aurora tilt their heads, bestowing a blessing of luck upon the faithful guardian. Calyx bats at the pulsing ribbons of light, absorbing the raw vitality of the bridge as it solidifies beneath her paws.
en.conclusion: Calyx chirrups in delight, her heart glowing with a steady, peaceful light. The fatigue of the past vanishes, replaced by a radiant strength. Her spirit is renewed, granting her {bonus} additional power.
